high_value_findings.finding: Tool-tag output sanitization was originally performed before tool dispatch, which disabled legitimate tools; the pipeline was later reordered so dispatch executes before presentation cleanup.
high_value_findings.transfer: Model output -> structured parse -> authority/policy -> execution -> typed result -> presentation sanitization must be explicit; presentation filters cannot consume execution metadata first.

high_value_findings.finding: Identity governors, regex cleaners, tool-output cleaners, safety prefilters and UI sanitizers materially transform model output and visible consciousness streams.
high_value_findings.transfer: Postprocessors are causal co-authors of behavior and require provenance, ordering tests and collateral-damage metrics rather than being treated as invisible formatting.

high_value_findings.finding: Continuous listening/conversation mode was removed in favor of explicit PTT plus minimum capture duration after reliability/false-trigger concerns.
high_value_findings.transfer: For noisy sensing that can trigger cognition/effects, explicit actuation and minimum evidence windows are a defensible reliability mode.

high_value_findings.finding: Image handling split OCR-only transcription from full generative description and exposed that choice explicitly to the user.
high_value_findings.transfer: Treat extracted text and generative scene interpretation as different evidence classes with different uncertainty/provenance.

high_value_findings.finding: Small-model agent drift was mitigated with plan refresh, large-result scratch offload and goal-based tool filtering. The shown scratch store is module-global despite session-scoped wording.
high_value_findings.transfer: Context engineering can improve bounded-agent focus, but scratch/context stores need explicit per-session namespaces and isolation tests before multi-user/concurrent use.

high_value_findings.finding: Telegram/WhatsApp bridges mapped external users into isolated session IDs but allowed all senders when no whitelist was configured.
high_value_findings.transfer: Remote ingress to an effect-capable chat/tool surface needs explicit authentication/capability scope and fail-closed defaults; session separation alone is not authorization.

high_value_findings.finding: Benchmark prominence changed, bio-inspired names were explicitly demoted to engineering metaphors, repository papers were relabeled non-peer-reviewed technical notes, dead Genesis docs were removed, and architecture docs were reconciled to a new topology.
high_value_findings.transfer: Evidence class, naming semantics, document epoch and active/dead topology are independent metadata dimensions and must survive historical synthesis.

negative_results_preserved: Presentation sanitization blocked legitimate tool execution when ordered before dispatch.
Continuous voice mode was removed after reliability/false-trigger concerns.
Static browser caching caused client/API mismatch during image-upload changes.
Internal tool/directive/memory metadata leaked into visible output surfaces.
A scratchpad described as session-scoped was module-global in the shown implementation and requires isolation verification.
Remote messaging bridges defaulted to allow-all when whitelist configuration was absent.
Dead Genesis architecture and outdated model/interface topology persisted in current documentation until cleanup.
measurement_boundary: No source-reported benchmark values, neural parameter counts, latency spikes, fix totals or safety-test results were independently reproduced in this semantic pass.

earned_work.reason: No row-level earned-work overlap audit was performed.
